sections: Overview
ConvertPDF (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. The ConvertPDF apps process your files locally on your device. We do not upload, store, or view your documents.
Your files
Conversion, merging, splitting, compression, OCR, redaction, annotation, and signing happen on your device. Your files are not transmitted to our servers for processing.
Information we may collect
We do not require an account to use the apps or to unlock Lifetime after purchase (Restore uses your Apple ID via Apple).
Optional, non-identifying crash or diagnostics data only if you opt in through the system or App Store.
Purchase / licence status for ConvertPDF Lifetime is handled by Apple In-App Purchase. We do not receive your full payment card details.
Information you choose to send when contacting support (for example an email about a refund request).
Payments and refunds

ConvertPDF Lifetime is a one-time non-consumable purchase priced at $4.99 USD (local currency may vary on the App Store). There is no subscription and no free trial. Apple bills the purchase. Our customer promise: within 14 days of purchase we support a full refund for any reason with no questions asked, via Support and/or Apple’s Report a Problem. Refunds are completed through Apple’s payment system.
Website
This marketing website does not require a login and does not process your PDF files. We may use essential hosting cookies. We do not sell personal information from this site.
Sharing

We do not sell personal information. We may share limited operational data with service providers who host this website, or where required by law. Apple processes App Store payments under Apple’s privacy policy.
Retention and security
App document processing stays on-device. Any support emails you send (including refund requests) are kept only as long as needed to help you.
Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data you sent us. Contact us to exercise them.
Children
ConvertPDF is not directed to children under 13.
Changes
We may update this policy and will post the new date here.
Contact
Privacy or refund questions: https://convertpdf.taqnik.in/en/support or support@convertpdf.app. You can also use App Store correspondence once the app is published.
